records.conditionQuote: It does not cover experiments, which follow their own process.

records.rationale: If 'usually' is part of the claim it already hedges and 'no minimum' only blocks a misreading (set); if the claim is 'lasts one working day', it reads as a required minimum the guide does not set (claim).

records.conditionQuote: chosen at random per request rather than per user

records.rationale: Read as 5% of users, u12 misdescribes exposure (claim); read as specifying u9's 'small share of real traffic', u9 stays true (set). Different claim links, both defensible.
